Change Adoption, Partnership and Risk Leadership

* Own adoption of the new operating model by ensuring retained teams, provider teams, people managers and business stakeholders are ready to operate effectively post\-transition.
* Lead change readiness activities in partnership with dedicated change resources, including stakeholder alignment, communications, training readiness, leadership engagement and adoption tracking.
